# rtorrent-mcp (qbt-mcp) — Full Reference

FastMCP 3.1 server for anime BitTorrent automation with Austrian legal context. Talks to rTorrent over XML-RPC/SCGI.

## Quick Facts

| Attribute | Value |
|-----------|-------|
| Python package | `rtorrent_mcp` |
| Version | 3.0.0 |
| FastMCP | 3.4.2+ |
| Python | >= 3.12 |
| Backend port | 10910 |
| Frontend port | 10911 |
| rTorrent XML-RPC | 12224 (Docker: crazymax/rtorrent-rutorrent) |
| Test | pytest + Playwright e2e (11 tests) |
| Desktop | Tauri 2.0 NSIS installer |
| Sampling | Ollama default, defer to host via env var |
| License | MIT |

## Ports

| Service | Port |
|---------|------|
| rTorrent XML-RPC (nginx) | 12224 |
| ruTorrent WebUI | 12222 |
| rtorrent-mcp backend (uvicorn) | 10910 |
| rtorrent-mcp frontend (Vite) | 10911 |

## Tools (7)

### torrent_management (13 actions)
add, list, pause, resume, delete, status, info, notify_media, check_completed, process, start_processing, stop_processing, normalize

### search_management (13 actions)
anime, manga, japanese_tv, movies, tv_shows, tv_smart, ebooks_annas, ebooks_pb, comics, annas_detail, imdb, imdb_search, tvdb

### system_management (5 actions)
help, status, health, info, analyze

### workflow_management (8 actions)
franchise, batch_series, status, cancel, list, estimate, queue, schedule

### nlp_management (3 actions)
command, parse, help

### legal_management (4 actions)
risk, check, advice, status

### agentic_rtorrent_workflow
LLM-orchestrated multi-step torrent workflow (requires Ollama or host sampling)

## Config (.env)

```
RTORRENT_HOST=localhost
RTORRENT_PORT=12224
OMDB_API_KEY=               # required for IMDb metadata
API_KEY=                    # optional REST API auth
RTORRENT_SAMPLING_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1
RTORRENT_SAMPLING_MODEL=llama3.2
```

See `.env.example` for full list.

## Architecture

```
FastMCP stdio / HTTP server
  ├── 6 portmanteau tools (torrent, search, nlp, legal, system, workflow)
  ├── 1 agentic workflow tool (LLM sampling)
  ├── 7 prompt templates
  ├── 11 resources (legal, nlp, search, TV, anime, rtorrent config)
  ├── 1 skill (rtorrent-mcp via SkillsDirectoryProvider)
  ├── REST API (/api/health, /api/info, /api/rtorrent/*)
  └── Starlette webapp + CORS

rTorrent XML-RPC client ←→ crazymax/rtorrent-rutorrent (Docker)

Search providers: nyaa.si (anime), Pirate Bay (TV), YTS (movies), Anna's Archive (ebooks)
Metadata: IMDb, TVDB
Media notify: Plex, Jellyfin
```

## REST API

All endpoints on port 10910:

- `GET /api/health` — server health
- `GET /api/info` — server info
- `POST /api/rtorrent/*` — rTorrent proxy
- `GET /api/capabilities - tool/resource/skill surface (dynamic discovery)
- GET /api/skills / GET /api/skills/{name} - bundled SKILL.md listing/content
- GET /api/llm/discover - probe Ollama :11434 / LM Studio :1234 / vLLM :8000
- POST /api/ai/chat - chat completion via the configured sampling endpoint
- GET /api/fleet/apps - probe the fleet webapp reservoir for live peers
- GET /api/v1/diagnostics - diagnostics (tools, system)

## Tauri Desktop

NSIS installer with embedded PyInstaller backend. Build:
```powershell
cd native
.\build.ps1
```
Produces `native/target/release/bundle/nsis/qBittorrent MCP_*_x64-setup.exe`.

## Development

```bash
# Install
uv sync

# Run backend
uv run python -m rtorrent_mcp --port 10910

# Run frontend (separate terminal)
cd web_sota && npm run dev

# Tests
uv run pytest
cd web_sota && npx playwright test

# Lint
ruff check src/
ruff format src/

# Desktop build
cd native && pwsh -File build.ps1

# MCPB pack
mcpb pack . dist/rtorrent-mcp.mcpb
```

## Known Gaps

- Workflow `franchise`/`batch_series` are stubs (not executing)
- Settings page in webapp is cosmetic (not wired to backend)
- Test coverage below 80% target
- ~52 legacy individual tool decorators still active alongside portmanteau tools
